dcterms:description: A synthetic dataset containing PHP code samples for various vulnerabilities, including SQL injection, Cross-site scripting, and OS Command injection. Each sample is a short standalone file with no external dependencies, generated by a tool called the PHP Vulnerability Test Suite Generator.
dcterms:title: SARD

dcterms:description: A dataset collected from GitHub containing real-world PHP projects with vulnerabilities. The dataset includes both vulnerable and non-vulnerable samples, extracted from the commit history of various PHP repositories based on known vulnerabilities.
dcterms:title: GIT
